description: Translate the second 100 Digimon profile records directly from the original Japanese.

english:
A mole-like
Digimon
that lives deep
underground. It
digs
through the
earth at
high speed with
the
huge drill on
its
nose. Usually
gentle,
it can be
mischievous
and sometimes
steals
the bones
Garurumon
hid
underground.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A ferocious
beast
Digimon covered
in
dark-brown fur.
It can
manipulate time
and
space, warp
through
other
dimensions, and
create special
spaces.
It can also
unleash
a shock wave
powerful
enough to
shatter rock.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A mutant
Digimon
made of earth
that
looks much like
Frigimon. It
seems
heavy, but can
move
with surprising
speed.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
It looks like a
lobster, but is
really
an aquatic
dragon
Digimon. It has
a hard
shell and huge
claws.
Fierce by
nature, it
is dangerous to
approach. It
lives in
the deep Net
Ocean.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
An octopus
Digimon
that gathers
anything
lying in the
Net Ocean
and wears it.
The claws
on its hands
came from
Devimon data. A
Shellmon
lives in the
pot on its
head and warns
it of
danger.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A squid Digimon
that looks
vicious,
but is
intelligent and
avoids
pointless
fights. Enter
its
territory
without leave,
though, and it
attacks
in a rage. It
spits
poisonous ink
that
paralyzes the
whole
body.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A Digimon whose
body structure
recalls
an ancient
fish. Its
fins developed
like
limbs, and its
hard
head gives it
strong
offense and
defense.
It is said to
be an
ancestor of
many
Digimon.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
An aquatic
Digimon
that resembles
a hermit
crab. Its shell
is hard,
but its body is
soft.
It settles in
anything
it can fit
inside, then
changes homes
as it
grows. Some
Shellmon
grow as large
as
a small
mountain.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
An ice Digimon
whose body is
made of
snow and ice
crystals.
Though cold to
the
touch, it has a
warm
heart. It
avoids
fighting and
lives
peacefully at
its
own pace.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A fallen-angel
Digimon with a
cold
body and heart.
It
shows no mercy
or
emotion, and
attacks
in ways that
make its
foes suffer. It
uses
many ice
techniques.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A dolphin-like
aquatic mammal
Digimon,
apparently
born from
software
that studies
language.
Very
intelligent, it
dislikes
fighting but
shows no
restraint
when attacked.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A plant Digimon
that resembles
a dead
tree. Fierce
and
violent, it
disguises
itself as an
ordinary
tree and
attacks
Digimon passing
by.
Its thick trunk
gives
it excellent
defense,
but it keeps
its
distance from
fire
Digimon.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
An insect
Digimon
that looks like
a
praying mantis.
It is
said to have
been
created in a
lab to
eliminate Virus
Digimon. Cold
and
precise, it
finishes
its target with
the
sharp scythes
on
both arms.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A bee-like
insect
Digimon that
flies at
extreme speed.
The
sound of its
wings is
so powerful it
can
paralyze the
sense of
hearing. Its
poisonous
stinger is
dangerous,
but can
regenerate
again and
again.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A
dragonfly-like
insect Digimon
that
flies through
the
network and
dives at
foes with its
sharp
fangs. It can
also
fire lightning
from
its tail.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A Digimon
dressed
like a ninja,
known
for its red
mask. It
uses the
ninjutsu of
the Iga school.
It
hides in
forests and
water,
traveling
quietly from
place
to place as it
trains.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A machine
Digimon
marked by a
huge
clock. It
manages
space-time in
the
network and can
freely
control time.
Neutral
by nature, it
shows
no mercy to
anyone
who attacks it.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A mutant
Digimon
thought to be
related
to Mamemon. Its
body
is a magnet
that
constantly
emits
electricity.
Small as
it is, it
fights back
with shocks,
punches,
and kicks when
attacked.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A tank-like
Digimon
that loves
conflict
and sides with
any
faction that
benefits
it. It has
terrifying
power and
sprays foes
with weapons
mounted
all over its
body.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A mineral
Digimon
whose body is
90%
rock. Its limbs
hold
it together and
keep
it alive, but
it cannot
move unless
ordered.
This clay doll
has an
ancient spell
carved
into its back.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A mutant
Digimon
shaped like a
gun
barrel and
dressed
as a
gunslinger. Its
strong sense of
justice
boils over when
it
sees evil. It
loves
gambling,
though, and
may let a
villain go
if it wins at
Russian
roulette.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A Digimon with
a
starfish-like
upper
body and
beast-like
legs. Its
trained right
arm is fused
with a
weapon. The
blue
substance on
its body
works as armor,
and
a fan on its
back lets
it move at
incredible
speed.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A wicked dragon
Digimon
summoned to
the Dark Area
by
Devimon. It
flies
through
darkness on
eerie wings. In
battle,
it glares with
red eyes
to freeze its
foe, then
rips it apart
with
blade-like
claws.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A spider-like
insect
Digimon whose
whole
body is
infected by
a computer
virus. It
corrupts
anything it
touches. Once
it picks
a target, its
eight
legs let it
catch up
and kill even a
foe
that runs at
full speed.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A phantom
original
dragon Digimon
that
is rarely seen.
Though
it is a dragon,
people
sometimes
mistake it
for a dog. It
has a
V-shaped mark
on its
chest and
immense
power; in a
crisis,
it may reach
Ultimate
and beyond.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A demon-like
Digimon
resembling
a foreign-game
virus
infected
samurai. Its
armor is
battered from
surviving
endless
battles. Its
beloved
sword,
Shiratamaru,
has a spell
that
drains its
foe's life.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A white puppet
Digimon shaped
like
a horse and
carrying
a huge dart. It
avoids
close combat,
relying
on the strength
of a
thoroughbred
and
leaping past
foes to
confuse them.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A Digimon that
evolved from
Coronamon.
It moves on
four legs
with a beast's
strength
and agility. It
flies
with the wings
on its
back, then
charges
foes while
wreathed in
flame. Its
special
move is Flame
Dive.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A Digimon that
evolved from
Lunamon.
It can leap to
great
heights and
darts
about nimbly.
It throws
sleep-inducing
bubbles
made by its
Moon
Gloves. Its
special
move is Moon
Night
Bomb.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A command
dragon
that aims to
become
a Virus Buster.
It
wears metal
plates in
Commander Mode.
Kind
at heart, it
fights
Virus Digimon
until
the enemy is
reduced
to dust.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A Digimon that
evolved from
Hyokomon.
It became a
rogue while
following the
way of
the sword, and
now
works as a
bodyguard.
It takes any
job for
payment, but
still has
a kind side
toward
the weak.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A fire Digimon
that carries
the power
of the
Legendary Ten
Warriors. Its
Digicore
is wrapped in
holy
flames called
Spiritual
Fire, letting
it control
fire at will.
It is an
incarnation and
guardian
god of the
Firewall.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A powerful,
bulky
cyborg Digimon
and
a worthy rival
to
Etemon. When
furious
or pushed past
MAX
energy, the
volcano
on its back
erupts.
It excels at
deep-
voiced
microphone
performances.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A cyborg
Digimon
evolved from
Greymon,
with over half
its body
mechanized. Its
attack
power is said
to equal
a nuclear
blast. It
launches
courage-type
missiles from
the hatch
on its chest.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A very lovely
puppet Digimon
that
looks like a
giant
teddy bear. A
zipper
on its back has
led to
rumors that
someone
is inside. Its
Lovely
Attack makes
foes feel
so happy that
they
lose their
fighting
spirit.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
An undead
Digimon
that kept
living even
after its body
rotted
from being
consumed
by battle. Now
only
bones remain.
It has
lost its
emotions and
knows only how
to
fight, so other
Digimon fear
it.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A cyborg
Digimon
that evolved
into a
stronger form
of
Mamemon. It is
about
the same size,
but
looks can be
deceiving:
90% of its body
is
mechanical,
including
a powerful
Psycho
Blaster gun in
its
left arm.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A humanoid
cyborg
Digimon built
as an
experiment to
complete
cyborg Digimon.
Every
action is
programmed.
It can defeat a
Digimon
below Ultimate
level
with one blow.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A mysterious
puppet
Digimon that
calls
itself the
"King of
Digimon." It
wears a
reinforced
monkey suit
that withstands
any
attack and
travels the
world to
battle. Some
say it secretly
controls
Monzaemon.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A cyborg
Digimon
modified by
humans.
It contains a
terrifying
program that
can
destroy
anything, yet
has powerful
security
measures. It
can even
enter protected
computer
networks and
fire missiles
from
both arms.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A tiny fairy
Digimon that
casts
spells by
chanting in
a language from
another
dimension. It
seals
foes'
abilities, then
knocks them out
with
a mighty blow.
It loves
pranks and can
make
computers go
haywire
with its wand,
Fairy
Tale.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A Perfect-level
Digimon shaped
like
a Digi-Egg,
said to
be the
beginning and
end of all
Digimon.
Its shell is as
hard
as an eggshell
and
it can unleash
attacks
so powerful its
foes
may never stand
again.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
An ancient
giant
Digimon that
looks
like a mammoth.
It has
amazing power
but
is weak to
heat. The
emblem on its
face
holds ancient
wisdom,
giving it
far-sight
and
extraordinary
hearing.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
An evolved form
of
Kuwagamon with
stronger
defenses.
Aggressive
and driven to
destroy,
it can track
foes with
its antennae.
Its claws
are even better
at
cutting through
anything.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
An amphibian
Digimon evolved
from
Gekomon, with a
topknot-like
feeler.
It is rumored
to have
been born from
karaoke
scoring
software. It
plays melodies
on the
horns from its
shoulders
and sings in a
deep,
commanding
voice.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A beautiful,
female
Archangel
Digimon.
Usually gentle,
it
never forgives
evil
or injustice
and keeps
attacking until
its foe
repents. Its
spirit
and power have
earned
it worship as a
goddess
of the Digital
World.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
A Digimon that
Tailmon Armor
Digivolved into
with
the Digi-Egg of
Sincerity. It
moves
through water
like a
jet and can
smell
underwater
scents from
a kilometer
away,
letting it
chase prey
without end.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
An ancient
crustacean
Digimon
born when a
computer
virus infected
a lab's
data bank. It
catches
foes with its
head
tentacles and
attacks
with the blade
on its
tail. In a
pinch, it
hides and uses
its
radar eye to
strike
back.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

english:
An aquatic
Digimon
that evolved
from
Seadramon to
survive
harsh
environments.
A lightning-sha
ped
blade grows
from its
head, its shell
is
harder, and its
body
is larger. It
tracks
foes like a
torpedo
and finishes
them off.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

An aquatic
beast-
man Digimon
evolved
from a virus
that
infected a
ship's
computer and
scrambled
its navigation.
Its
tentacles form
a
humanoid shape,
but
its true form
is said
to be hideous.
It is
called the
"Sea's
Destroying
Weed."
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

A Digimon that
evolved from
Garurumon
and can now
walk on
two legs. It
has
excellent
all-around
combat ability,
a
strong sense of
justice,
and always
follows
the right path
and
its master's
orders.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

The king of
undead
Digimon,
revived by
dark magic. It
can
restore data
destroyed
by computer
viruses
with evil
viruses. Very
cunning and
hard to
banish, it is
said to
lose power in
daylight.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

A high-ranking
female
fallen-angel
Digimon. Its
powerful
dark energy
makes it
rare outside of
individual
computers
where it is
raised.
It uses
terrifying
attacks that
incinerate
its foes.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

A heroic
Digimon
that loves
justice
and nature,
protecting
the earth and
wind.
When the
Digital
World's order
is lost,
it appears from
nowhere
to guide things
back
to the right
path. It
is a close
friend of
Leomon and
shares
his ideals.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

A plant Digimon
shaped like a
giant
flower, with
many
tentacles
growing from
its body. Quiet
and
gentle, it
lives out
of sight near
water.
Each season,
its petals
fall and new
ones
grow.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

A fairy Digimon
born from a
flower.
A refreshing
breeze
is said to blow
when
it flies.
Capricious
and lively, it
is kind
to the small
and weak,
and opens its
heart
to girls of a
similar
temperament.

An insect
Digimon
from a
MegaKabuterimon
subspecies
discovered
in a tropical
network
area. It seems

better than
Blue
MegaKabuterimon
.

been seen
protecting
the weak like a
knight.
blocks.review_note: Original Japanese profile translated directly; Western Digimon spellings and established terms are checked against linked English references where used.

A tiny machine
Digimon
developed for
medical

was originally

broken
computers, but

its
logic circuits.
Now it
causes healthy
systems
to malfunction.

A
dragon-humanoid
cyborg Digimon
wearing
armor made of
special
rubber. The
armor
provides
excellent

its attack
power. It

Virus Digimon

computer
networks.

An Archangel

priest, it

A holy beast
Digimon shaped
like
the rabbit from
an
Eastern legend.
It
controls the
"qi"

unleash
a powerful
strike.

the "Spider

An undead
Digimon

"Necromancer"

Digizoid.

ground.

A cyborg
Digimon
evolved from
Gargomon,
called the
"Swift
Hound." It
defeats
foes with
near-sonic

large ear

distant
targets, and
